sentences.text: The petitioner has moved an application before the High Court for modification of the conditions in terms of the liberty granted by this Court vide order dated 24062022 passed in Special Leave Petition (Crl.) No.5749/2022.

3. During the pendency of the modification application, the petitioner, for the reasons best known to him, filed second anticipatory bail application in the Court of Sessions Judge, Patna, which was declined on 04012023.
Against that order, the petitioner has come to this Court contending that the application for modification of the conditional anticipatory order is still pending consideration before the High Court.
4. This Court on 24042023 requested the High Court for early consideration of the abovestated application and meanwhile directed that no coercive steps be taken against the petitioner.
5. We are informed that the application for modification of the earlier order moved by the petitioner is listed before the High Court in the middle of June, 2023.

6. Under these circumstances, but without expressing any views on the merits of the case, we dispose of the Special Leave Petition, reiterating our request to Honble the Chief Justice of Patna High Court to ensure that the abovestated application for modification may be listed at the earliest and preferably within second or third week of June, 2023.
7. Till disposal of the modification application, the interim protection granted on 24042023 by this Court shall continue to operate.

(VISHAL ANAND) (PREETHI T.C.)
ASTT. REGISTRARcumPS COURT MASTER (NSH)
